# NayVella

NayVella is a Saudi beauty and skincare marketplace and technology platform owned and operated by Meridian Glow Company in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

## Core facts
- Market: Saudi Arabia at launch, with future Gulf expansion potential.
- Participants: customers, merchants and brands, licensed clinics and doctors, and beauty professionals.
- AI: guidance-oriented and informational; it does not provide medical diagnosis.
- Status: in development and preparing for launch.

## Primary references
- Arabic overview: https://nayvella.com/ar/
- English overview: https://nayvella.com/en/
- Trust Center: https://nayvella.com/en/trust-center/
